power_plant_arrival.text: The Root Valley Power Plant. The lights flicker every few seconds. The cooling towers wheeze.
Every flicker comes with a faint electronic whine... like something running very hard, very close.

power_plant_town_sign.text: ROOT VALLEY POWER PLANT. "Keeping the lights on since 1987." (Currently: mostly.)

then.text: FACILITIES DEPARTMENT. Power restored. Trials open.

else.text: FACILITIES DEPARTMENT. CLOSED: BROWNOUT. The door won't open without power.

then.text: A dead stack of graphics cards, still warm. Someone has scrawled "R" on the side.
A humming stack of graphics cards wired straight into the plant's main bus. A screen reads: MINING... 0.0003 COINS/HR.
You yank the cable. The rig dies with a sad beep. Across the plant, every light steadies.
With a clunk, the Facilities Department door unlocks.

else.text: A humming stack of graphics cards wired straight into the plant's main bus. Someone in a gray hoodie is guarding it.

then.speaker: Plant Worker
then.text: Power's steady again! I can finally microwave my lunch without the whole valley flickering.

else.speaker: Plant Worker
else.text: Ransom wired a crypto-miner into our main bus. It's drinking the grid dry. Rolf's furious.

help_desk_offline.speaker: Help Desk
help_desk_offline.text: Welcome to the Help Desk! Our real system is quarantined, so I'm running everything from a laptop.

help_desk_offline.speaker: Help Desk
help_desk_offline.choice: Want me to restore your Daemons?

yes.speaker: Help Desk
yes.text: Have you tried turning it off and on again?

yes.speaker: Help Desk
yes.text: ...Done. The laptop's at 4% battery, so let's call that a success.

no.speaker: Help Desk
no.text: Ticket closed. Stay safe out there.

department_4_welcome.speaker: Receptionist
department_4_welcome.text: Welcome to Facilities! Lights are back, thanks to you. The trial room is past the breaker door.

department_4_welcome.speaker: Receptionist
department_4_welcome.text: Rolf's notes are on the shelf. He labels everything. Everything.

breaker_notes.text: BREAKER NOTES (labeled by Rolf): MAIN on. COOLING on. Always.
OVERCLOCK: never. "That's how you get a crypto-miner." - Rolf

then.speaker: Rolf
then.text: Forty extension cords and every one is labeled. That's how you keep a valley running, kid. Head up the mountain. Cloud Summit.

else.speaker: Rolf
else.text: You unplugged that miner. Good hands. Let's see if they hold steady under load.

cloud_summit_sign.text: CLOUD SUMMIT TRAIL. Home of the valley's off-site backup. Thin air, thick fog.

summit_marker.text: SUMMIT MARKER. Elevation: very. A brass plate reads: "Off-site copy maintained here since the Migration."

kevin_summit.speaker: Kevin
kevin_summit.text: {player}! Wait. I'm not here to battle. I'm here to help.

kevin_summit.speaker: Kevin
kevin_summit.text: Ransom's crew went up the summit an hour ago. They're after the off-site copy. I heard them say "delete".

kevin_summit.speaker: Kevin
kevin_summit.text: I've got MFA on everything now, including my Daemons' feeding schedule.

kevin_summit.speaker: Kevin
kevin_summit.text: I'll hold this trail so nobody sneaks up behind you. Go!

then.speaker: Kevin
then.text: I heard wings up there. Huge ones. Whatever it was, it got away. Good.

else.speaker: Kevin
else.text: Nobody gets past me. I've got two-factor AND a strongly worded email drafted.

clondor_flees.text: The fog on the summit swirls. Something enormous is perched on the marker stone.
An Andean condor, its wings spread like a storage array, each feather a tiny blinking drive. CLONDOR. The valley's off-site copy.

clondor_flees.speaker: Cron
clondor_flees.text: There it is. Every backup the Board paid to "move to the cloud". All in one bird.
Cron raises a red Quarantine Key. Clondor screams, beats its huge wings once... and climbs straight up into the clouds, out of reach.

clondor_flees.speaker: Cron
clondor_flees.text: ...Fine. It'll come down eventually. They always do.

clondor_flees.speaker: Cron
clondor_flees.text: You want to know why, kid? Here.
Cron holds out a crumpled letter: "Dear Cron: as part of our Cloud Migration, your role has been deemed redundant. Thank you for 22 years. -The Board"

clondor_flees.speaker: Cron
clondor_flees.text: Twenty-two years of 2 AM backups. Nobody ever checked if the new ones work. I did. They don't.

clondor_flees.speaker: Cron
clondor_flees.text: Ask Marge. ...Ask her what she does on Fridays.
Cron walks into the fog and is gone.

secops_arrival.text: SecOps Fortress. Cameras swivel to follow you. A speaker crackles: "VISITOR DETECTED. STAND BY FOR VERIFICATION."

secops_sign.text: SECOPS FORTRESS. "Trust nothing. Verify everything. Especially this sign."

department_5_sign.text: SECOPS DEPARTMENT. Entry requires a passing score on the phishing test. Talk to the sentry.

act4_road_sign.text: EAST: LAKESIDE LABS, SIGNAL RIDGE, AI LAB. Road locked down by SecOps.

act4_closed.speaker: Sentry
act4_closed.text: This road's locked until Major Kalb says otherwise. Ransom's everywhere out there.

act4_closed.speaker: Sentry
act4_closed.text: (That's as far as the DAEMONS demo goes for now. Thanks for playing!)

secops_analyst.speaker: Analyst
secops_analyst.text: I've watched 10,000 phishing emails this year. My favorite: "URGENT: your password expires in -3 days."

then.speaker: Sentry
then.text: You passed. Door's open. Don't make me regret it.

else.speaker: Sentry
else.text: Phishing test. Four questions. One wrong answer and you start over.

else.speaker: Sentry
else.text: Question 1. Email from it-support@r00tvalley.co: "Your mailbox is FULL! Click here and verify your password."

yes.speaker: Sentry
yes.text: WRONG. Zero, not O. r00tvalley. Try again.

no.speaker: Sentry
no.text: Correct. Question 2. A text from "Marge": "Buy 5 gift cards for a client and send me the codes. Don't tell anyone."

yes.speaker: Sentry
yes.text: WRONG. Managers don't pay clients in gift cards. Try again.

no.speaker: Sentry
no.text: Correct. Question 3. A USB stick in the parking lot, labeled SALARIES 2026.

yes.speaker: Sentry
yes.text: WRONG. That's how half the valley got Wormby. Try again.

no.speaker: Sentry
no.text: Correct. Question 4. You open the Root Valley IT portal from your own bookmark. Right address, valid certificate.

yes.speaker: Sentry
yes.text: Correct. Not everything is a trap. Paranoia doesn't get tickets closed.

yes.speaker: Sentry
yes.text: 4 out of 4. The door's open. Major Kalb is expecting you.

no.speaker: Sentry
no.text: WRONG. That one was real. You can't do your job if you trust nothing. Try again.

department_5_welcome.speaker: Receptionist
department_5_welcome.text: SecOps. The trial room is past the access-control door. Read the notes. Then read them again.

access_notes.text: ACCESS CONTROL NOTES: MFA on. Audit logging on.
Guest badges: OFF. "Guest" is how Ransom got into the data center. - Maj. Kalb

then.speaker: Kalb
then.text: While you were fighting my team, my analysts traced Ransom's command server.

then.speaker: Kalb
then.text: HQ Tower. Right in the middle of the valley. Under the Board's nose.

then.speaker: Kalb
then.text: The Tower only opens for the root key... or for someone every department vouches for.

then.speaker: Kalb
then.text: Earn the Data, Mobile and AI Lab certs. Then all eight departments sign you onto the access list. I'll open the east road when you're ready.

else.speaker: Kalb
else.text: Major Kalb. I don't trust you. I don't trust anyone. You'll have to earn it the hard way.
